userdoc.notice: A small clearinghouse for Bitcoin perpetual swaps between two traders. Each trade has one long and one short account. Settlement pays the price change since the last settlement, plus funding, from the losing account to the winning one, in tUSDC. If the loser has run out of tUSDC, the clearinghouse turns its sBILL into tUSDC: through the fund on business days, and by selling it to the weekend vault (at a small discount) when the fund is closed. The owner can pause new deposits and new trades, and post the funding rate within a fixed cap. Settlement, liquidation, closing and withdrawals keep working while paused.
